def find_index(target, arr):
    start = 0
    end = len(arr) - 1
    while start <= end:
        mid = (start + end) // 2
        if arr[mid] == target:
            return mid
        if target > arr[mid]:
            start = mid + 1
        else:
            end = mid - 1
    return -1

def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    max_segment = 0
    total_w = 0
    sequence = list(input().strip())

    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if sequence[i] != '_' and sequence[i] != '(':
            segment_count = 0
            j = i
            while j < n:
                if sequence[j] != '_' and sequence[j] != '(':
                    segment_count += 1
                if sequence[j] == '_' or sequence[j] == '(' or j == n - 1:
                    max_segment = max(max_segment, segment_count)
                    i = j
                    break
                j += 1
        if sequence[i] == '(':
            count = 0
            j = i
            while j < n:
                if (sequence[j] == '_' or sequence[j] == ')') and count > 0:
                    total_w += 1
                    count = 0
                if sequence[j] == ')':
                    i = j
                    break
                if sequence[j] != '_' and sequence[j] != '(':
                    count += 1
                j += 1
        i += 1
    print(f"{max_segment} {total_w}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
